factors.value_notes: NOAA EFH reports all-occurrence SST around 15–30 °C and abundant occurrence around 20–29 °C; an Atlantic/Indian habitat study reports 18–30 °C association and 23–28 °C preference. This provides good broad support for 18–30 °C / 20–28 °C, but ocean-basin and stock differences remain.
